about: A 3D model or scene the learner can rotate or move through.

cases.text: I want to rotate a model of a DNA double helix and look at it from every side.
Build a scene where I can see the earth, moon and sun orbiting in space.
Show the inside of a jet engine as something I can spin around and inspect.
Make a spatial model of a benzene ring that I can move around.
Set up a model of the solar system I can fly through.
Give me a rotatable model of a cube and its diagonals.
